title: Steve Carell Almost Played ‘The Office’ Creator Greg Daniels’ Dad in Biopic About the 1968 Olympics
content:
ByMarc Malkin

Senior Editor, Culture and Events

Steve Carelland writerGreg Danielsgot so close while making “The Office,” they became like family.

So much so that Daniels once wanted Carell to play his dad Aaron in a biopic he wrote about him almost 20 years ago.

“He’s a very colorful person and he actually was in the Olympics in 1968, and I wrote a movie for Steve to play him, like on spec during the writers strike of 2008,” Daniels told me at hisHollywood Walk of Famestar unveiling on Thursday morning. (Writers were allowed to write uncommissioned spec scripts during the 2008 strike.)

What was his sport?

“He had a very rare sport. That’s how he was able to do it,” Daniels explained. “It was the demonstration sport of Mexico, basically like jai alai but with paddles and so he managed to wrangle his way in with some friends.”

The elder Daniels competed as an amateur athlete in the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City.

“The Office” creator Greg Daniels reveals Steve Carell almost played his dad in a biopic Daniels wrote nearly 20 years ago:“He’s a very colorful person and he actually was in the Olympics in 1968, and I wrote a movie for Steve to play him, like on spec during the writers…pic.twitter.com/BrEQsBC3Rx

Carell, along with Conan O’Brien, spoke at the star unveiling. “Everyone told me not to do ‘The Office,’” Carell said. “[They said] it will not work. The original is too good. It is a waste of time. And mostly, it is just going to stink. And then a crazy thing happened. It didn’t stink because of Greg Daniels.”

During our chat, Daniels put the kibosh on fans’ hopes for any sort of “Office” revival or reboot. “I don’t think we need to find out what all the characters are doing so much because of the way the show ended,” he said. “It seemed like people liked the ending and you’re just sort of risking a lot to open it up again.”

Daniels adapted “The Office” from the British series of the same name. It premiered in 2005 before ending after nine seasons in 2013.
title_zh: 史提夫·卡瑞爾(Steve Carell)差點在關於1968年奧運會的傳記片中飾演《辦公室》(The Office)創作者格雷格·丹尼爾斯(Greg Daniels)的父親。
content_zh:
作者：馬克·馬爾金(Marc Malkin)

資深編輯，文化與活動

史蒂夫·卡瑞爾(Steve Carell)和編劇格雷格·丹尼爾斯(Greg Daniels)在製作《辦公室(The Office)》的過程中變得非常親近，幾乎像家人一樣。

丹尼爾斯甚至曾希望卡瑞爾能在他大約20年前寫的傳記電影中飾演他的父親亞倫(Aaron)。

“他是一個非常多彩的人，實際上在1968年參加過奧運會，我在2008年編劇罷工期間為史蒂夫寫了一部他來飾演的電影，”丹尼爾斯在他好萊塢星光大道的星星揭幕儀式上告訴我。（在2008年的罷工期間，編劇們被允許撰寫未委託的樣本劇本。）

他的運動是什麼？

“他參加的是一項非常罕見的運動。這就是他能夠參加的原因，”丹尼爾斯解釋道。“這是墨西哥的示範運動，基本上像是用球拍的哈雅利(Jai Alai)，所以他設法和一些朋友一起進入了這個領域。”

丹尼爾斯的父親作為業餘運動員參加了1968年在墨西哥城舉行的夏季奧運會。

《辦公室(The Office)》創作者格雷格·丹尼爾斯透露，史蒂夫·卡瑞爾差點在他近20年前寫的傳記電影中飾演他的父親：“他是一個非常多彩的人，實際上在1968年參加過奧運會，我在2008年編劇罷工期間為史蒂夫寫了一部他來飾演的電影……”

卡瑞爾和康納·奧布萊恩(Conan O'Brien)在揭幕儀式上發表了講話。“每個人都告訴我不要拍《辦公室(The Office)”，卡瑞爾說。“[他們說]這不會成功。原版太好了。這是浪費時間。而且大多數情況下，這將會很糟糕。然後發生了一件瘋狂的事情。因為格雷格·丹尼爾斯，它並沒有糟糕。”

在我們的交談中，丹尼爾斯對粉絲對任何形式的《辦公室(The Office)》復興或重啟的希望泼了冷水。“我不認為我們需要知道所有角色現在在做什麼，因為節目的結局就是這樣，”他說。“看起來人們喜歡這個結局，而重新開啟這個故事冒著很大的風險。”

丹尼爾斯將《辦公室(The Office)》改編自同名的英國系列。該劇於2005年首播，並在2013年結束，總共播出了九季。
